title: UI Interaction, Inbox by @jeetnirnejak: Inbox Autopilot: a mini inbox. archive by swipe, or auto-clean the noi
notes:
Inbox Autopilot: a mini inbox. archive by swipe, or auto-clean the noise and leave the real mail alone. if you touch the list mid-sweep, auto stops and the rest is yours. when it runs again it only hits leftover junk and never reopens what you already archived.

Designer: @jeetnirnejak. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
